content: {"reasoning": "The denial is CO-197 (no prior auth at time of service); the payer offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer, so those paths are barred, and resubmitting as-is or with records would just re-deny. Claim data and COB order are already correct, and an auth-failure balance is provider liability, so billing the patient would be improper and write-off is premature with 152 days of filing time left. The only legitimate remaining avenue is a formal appeal arguing medical necessity, supported by the valid I48.91/I48.0 pairing and available documentation.", "action": "appeal_with_necessity"}
